title: National Commission on the Status of Women Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: National Commission on the Status of Women Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2018
ACT II OF 2018
NATIONAL COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF
WOMEN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the National Commission on the
Status of Women Act, 2012
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd February, 2018]
No.F.24(14)/2017-Legis,
dated 1.2.2018.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 30th January, 2018 and is hereby
published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient to amend the National Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012
(VIII of 2012) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the National Commission on
the Status of Women (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

No.F.24(14)/2017-Legis,
dated 1.2.2018.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 30th January, 2018 and is hereby
published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient to amend the National Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012
(VIII of 2012) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of
section 4, Act VIII of 2012.---In the National
Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012 (VIII of 2012), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 4, after subsection (5), the following
new subsection shall be added, namely:-
"(6) A
vacancy of Chairperson shall be filled in as provided in this Act within thirty
days of occurrence of the vacancy.".
